items: Dusty key, or another way to get into the deep Taverley Dungeon

st.t: Go to the Arceuus library and find The Soul journey book in one of the bookcases, then read it. You can ask Biblia for help locating it.
Talk to Aretha at the Soul Altar, in the far north-east of Arceuus.
Go to the Arceuus church, east of the library. Climb up a staircase to get inside, then climb down the inner staircase to the courtyard in the centre. Dig anywhere there for the Damaged soul bearer.
Go to Taverley Dungeon, or teleport to the Key Master directly.
i: Dusty key, or another way to get into the deep Taverley Dungeon

st.t: Go through the gate into the deep part of Taverley Dungeon with your dusty key, or by another way in. Enter the cave in the hellhound area at the north end to reach the Key Master.
